summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK-style PDMR notification (the US-equivalent Form 4 disclosure) covering a purchase of ordinary shares by Non-Executive Director Karen Guerra. She acquired 6,000 ordinary shares at 42.544825 pence each on 2026-10-14 on the London Stock Exchange, an aggregate consideration of approximately GBP 255,268.95. No board recommendation, advisor, stake percentage, premium or structural terms appear. The transaction is a routine insider open-market buy with no change to control; watch for further PDMR dealings but no deal or risk-arb angle exists.
